title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 7: Kaori Asou
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．７ ～麻生かおり～
overview:
The girl everyone's talking about from the Tokyo Telemessage commercial appears on Private Idol Disc!!

Volume 7 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Kaori Asou, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, get to know her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

東京テレメッセージのCMで話題のあの娘がプラドルDISCに登場!!
